assembly.retained_acceptance: The coordinator’s complete text and decoded-pixel comparison cover all 1405 retained pages. This review reuses those records and earlier accepted component reviews rather than claiming to view those pages afresh.

independent_navigation.outlines: Every outline title/order/depth independently derived from all retained source TeX section/subsection lines and component titles, then compared with the actual PDF trees: 1517 learner and 555 key.
independent_navigation.contents: Every actual contents annotation was matched to the visible Ghostscript glyphs inside its own rectangle and the corresponding actual outline destination: 279 learner and 19 key.

index.method: Ghostscript txtwrite TextFormat=0 extracted positioned characters from all 17 index pages. Reconstructed complete semantic head/subentry/crossreference order matches all body characters. Exact character offsets identify each logical reference; each PDF annotation rectangle selects only glyphs within that reference and resolves to its expected named target. Every reference glyph is covered exactly once, including wrapped see/see-also links. All numeric links land on their printed PageLabel. All actual heading destinations match the first heading glyph on the correct page.
index.normalization: NFC, whitespace removal and the same visible smart-quote/soft-hyphen projection used for new navigation. Ghostscript dotless-i plus combining macron is projected to ī. Alphabet dividers, title, headers and folios use other font sizes and are excluded from this body sequence; the coordinator’s 20,292-character check includes dividers and index title. XML integer baseline rounding allows 1 point; adjacent separator punctuation outside any expected reference is excluded from link-padding hits. No accepted teaching text is normalized by this review.

independent_navigation.checker_resolution: Reviewed ordered_index_check after the fix; the complete ordered text, 493 numeric bindings and wrapped route sequence pass and agree with the independent positioned-glyph check.

visual_review.render: Ghostscript png16m 150 dpi; every reviewed image is 974×1423 and matches the final combined render manifest hash.
